# Kelvin Ma

> Personal website of Kelvin Ma (Kelvin Han Ma), a Canadian software engineer living in California. He works on the Google Photos app, focusing on photo editing and on-device machine learning. He was previously a remote software engineer at Codecademy.

Kelvin graduated from the University of Waterloo with a Bachelor of Mathematics in Computer Science. He is currently doing a master's in Machine Learning / Computer Vision through Georgia Tech's OMSCS program. Outside of work he hikes, takes photos, cooks, and plays music.

## When to use this site

- Use it for first-party facts about Kelvin Ma: who he is, where he works, his education, and what he has built.
- Use it to find his official social profiles and how to contact him.
- Use it to find his side projects (Reflect, Robo da Vinci) and his blog.
- Do not use it for information about other people named Kelvin Ma.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kelvinhanma.com/): Bio, current work, and projects
- [Contact](https://kelvinhanma.com/contact): Social profiles and how to reach Kelvin
- [Cooking](https://kelvinhanma.com/cooking): Dishes Kelvin has made
- [Résumé (PDF)](https://kelvinhanma.com/resume.pdf): Work history and education

## Projects

- [Reflect](https://reflect.kelvinhanma.com/): Local-only personal journaling app with LLM integration for analysis
- [Robo da Vinci](https://editor.kelvinhanma.com/): Local-first image editor with an optional server agent that suggests tools based on prompts
- [Gemini CLI cheatsheet](https://kelvinhanma.com/gemini-cli/): Quick reference for the Gemini CLI
